'''Revelation Quiet Mining Colony''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Published:''' 19 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]

== Strategy ==

Okay?first turn deploy a CC site. Save force. Next turn, deploy another CC site, pull CC Celebration with Wokling. Third turn, deploy another CC site. If you haven?t deployed anything, you?ve activated 18 by yourself by now. Get somebody to Bespin, control two CC sites (preferably with some evasion in hand); flip. Now each turn take a card out of your force pile and beatdown opponent. I?ve got weird stuff like Antilles Maneuver, Life Debt, and stuff because I can pull them out of my force pile. Normally cards that are too specific are now good! Pucumir Thryss adds to my drains at CC. On the next turn, reinforce Bespin and deploy CC Celebration.  You?re all set now. 2-1B(V) is great in this deck- your lost characters go to used pile, then next turn you pull them up again : ). My first attempt at a QMC deck- comments appreciated.
